~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ site01-hub1 building router hsrp ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

! ########### VRF START ########### 
!
ip vrf {VRF_name}
  rd 64000:{RD_ID}
  route-target export 64000:{RD_ID}
  route-target import 64000:{RD_ID}
!
vlan {Vlan_ID_user}
  name {FW_context_name}-VRFGLUE={VRF_name}
!
!
! ########### VRF END ############# 

! ########### USER PREFIX START ########### 
changeto context {FW_context_name}
!
no route {VRF_name} {User_prefix} {User_prefix_netmask} {GW-VRFGLUE_IP}
!
no access-list {VRF_name}_access_in extended permit ip {User_prefix} {User_prefix_netmask} any
!
object-group network VRF_{VRF_name}_Subnets
  no network-object {User_prefix} {User_prefix_netmask}
!
! ########### USER PREFIX END #############
